Application Fee
HK$780 for payment via the on-line application system
Composition Fee for 2026/27 (payable in two instalments)
Full-time: HK$47,000 per year
Part-time: HK$63,000 per year
Notes:
The fees are reviewed annually.
The composition fee will be subject to the prevailing rate of the year of study. The composition fee for 2026/27 and 2027/28 will be HK$47,000 and HK$49,500 respectively for full-time studies.
Since July 1, 2018, the University Grants Committee waives composition fees for all local students enrolled in full-time UGC-funded RPg programmes. Click here for details.
Part-time research degree programmes are offered on a self-funded basis.
Please click here for the schedule of fees.
